reviews.text:
Be very careful! This is a company who cares more about there bottom line than the pets you entrust to them! If you want simple treatment fleas/ticks etc they are for you and they will over charge for even that!

They use trainees and charge specialist prices. Dont know there limits and delay referring to specialists when they are incapable of actually addressing the underlining issue. The arrogance of the booking team is what caused the main issue and they took 2 weeks to call back when a referral was requested even after numerous chaser calls explaining that the animal was suffering, just because they want to charge more. They just want to throw treatments at the issue and see whats sticks whilst over charging.

Disgusting behaviour, stay away from this chain/franchise they take advantage of location for custom. I for one will never use them again and urge you to do the same. The state of the veterinary decay is because of company's like this killing the smaller practices.
Overpriced prescriptions, they charged me over £90 for some tablets you can get online for around £20.
Always very kind to me and really involved with my dog illness. Everyone is nice to me and my dog every time I am there for an appointment

The visit to the Vet was a great experience! The reception staff is so welcoming and friendly! Dr Brianna was super caring in the check up process especially that my dog had anxiety and inflammation in his years

All the process was reassuring with treatment, guidance explained and follow up visit

Thank you for such a lovely service! Your professionalism means a lot!

We had a really positive experience with this vet and are so grateful for how well they looked after our cat. He was admitted after having difficulty urinating and some blood in his urine. The tests showed crystals in his bladder and urethra. The vet explained everything very clearly, including what was happening, the risks and the treatment he needed, which really helped put our minds at ease.

He stayed in hospital for two nights and was very well cared for. The nurses called us every day with updates, which we really appreciated.

We felt he was in very good hands throughout. It was such a relief to bring him home and see him happy, playful and back to himself again.
A big thank you to the whole team for taking such great care of him!
Great professional services every time I bring my pet in. Couldn't be happier with them.
Very helpful, friendly and patient. I have nothing but positive feedback for them.
Small dog  very good service

The staff were very amazing and kind and helped us and answered all
Our questions

The team is kind, patient, and genuinely cares. They handle my Shiba Inu beautifully, even when he is extremely stressed and needs meds to handle a vet visit. Pricing is transparent, and I’ve never been pushed into procedures that feel unnecessary.

The team at Vets for Pets Charlton are amazing. Caring and compassionate to animals and owners. I have 2 dogs, 4 cats and 12 guinea pigs and use vet services quite a bit. I travel quite a way to use the practice because I trust the team to care for my precious pets. Recently needed to attend as an emergency twice and the care from the whole team was amazing. As a nurse ( humans) myself I really appreciate their communication as well as clinical expertise. Importantly if they don’t know they say do and seek advise from specialists

I have always loved Vets for Pets but today proved even so more why. I was very lucky to have Kirsty, Joe and Kelly not once but twice today for my poorly boy but each time they were so kind, caring and incredibly remarkable in the next steps with helping my boy recover from a very bad eye Ulcer and in doing everything they can in preventing it worsening. Honestly 10/10, forever have my hats off to you guys. From me and Maui x
Appointment was on time. Receptionist was very nice and polite. The vet, Brianna, was very professional. Was gentle with my dog when giving her a health check and vaccinations.
This is a fantastic vet, from the reception to Dr Conor the vet, everyone is very kind and approachable. I can't thank them enough.

Nurses struggled with basic clinical competencies and lacked appropriate manual handling skills.  Treatment pods too small and not fit for use - poor airflow and claustrophobic.  Also tried to upsell irrelevant services. Little empathy shown. Self reflective work, clinical auditing
and staff training may be helpful here.

Unfortunately, this clinic has gone from good to bad to awful in a period of a few years. From vets who cannot draw blood or handle a very easy pet, to not being able to get my appointment despite being on time, but the front desk was on the phone, so "I was late", but every time I am "on time", I still have to wait 20 mins for them. Disappointed.

Terrible service, I asked the receptionist if I could speak to the manager, was told no manager there until Monday so I asked to speak to someone in charge and was informed that there was nobody in charge over the weekend. That's terrible and scary to think that if there was an incident or emergency then nobody responsible available.
Staff seem untrained, unprofessional and uncouth. They don’t even bother to answer the phone properly. Flee such establishments.
staffs are friendly & pets are looked after well.

Professional negligence: No medical help given, only empty promises
​  I brought my 11-month-old registered breeding Maine Coon,Sura, to this clinic seeking help. I wasn't even seen by a veterinarian; instead, I was seen by a vet assistant. The only solution offered was immediate sterilization, which is unacceptable for a breeding animal. To deny a registered cat even a chance to have kittens without exploring medical alternatives is unprofessional. I am not a large-scale breeder, but I wanted to give my beautiful, registered cat a chance to have a future in breeding.
​The assistant simply sent me home with my cat, providing no medical assistance at all. He promised to speak with the veterinarian and personally call and write to me within 4 days with an answer. It has been a month, and I never received any contact.
I was lucky that I was traveling abroad shortly after. In Europe, I was able to treat Sura successfully using Alizin (developed by Virbac, France). While this clinic claimed it is 'only for dogs,' it is a recognized treatment for both dogs and cats across Europe and is the gold standard for treating fibroadenomatous hyperplasia without surgery.
I am deeply disappointed by the lack of care, the broken promises, and the outdated medical advice.
If you value your pet’s health and your time, look elsewhere.

I called them on 14th Jan as a fox was hit by a car 5 minutes from their Charlton branch.  This was after 7PM so one of the only vets still open.  The receptionist was uncaring and refused to help showing no emotion or concern towards the fox.

Despite being reminded they have a duty to help wildlife and at least provide pain relief.  She checked with her colleagues and still came back and refused.  I managed to find another vet further away who cared enough to treat this poor animal.  I would never recommend using this awful place as they are evidently only interested in making money.

I had a really positive experience with Conor. He took over my cat’s critical care last week and was excellent throughout. He handled my cat very calmly and carefully, which made a stressful situation much easier.

Conor was also very thorough in explaining everything — he took the time to go over the details clearly, repeated key points so I could write them down, and made sure I understood all the options available. He also walked me through the different prescription diet solutions and explained why each might be appropriate.

I really appreciated how patient and reassuring he was, and how much care he showed both my cat and me. Highly recommend.

This is the third time I’ve left feeling really upset, and unfortunately it’s time for me to change vets.

I arrived 10 minutes late to my appointment due to an Uber driver refusing to take me with my very small pet. I understand transport issues aren’t the clinic’s responsibility, but when I arrived, I was told my appointment had been given to the person before me and there was no flexibility to see me in the next slot. I was asked to rebook for another day, despite already being there.

What upsets me most is not just this situation, but the overall lack of humanity I’ve experienced over time. The prices for medication feel excessive, and the approach increasingly feels more about money than care. Even though vaccinations are included in the monthly care plan I pay for, the service itself feels rushed and transactional.

I don’t want to argue or go back and forth; I’ve simply decided it’s time to move on. I’m leaving this review so others can make an informed decision and hopefully avoid similar experiences.
Lovely reception staff and an extra shout out to Victoria the tech/nurse today for being an absolute star with my two anxious sausage dogs. Thank you!

I’ve been a client here for years, and my cat has had ongoing health issues with no real progress or clear diagnosis. Today was the last straw. I arrived 12 minutes late after calling repeatedly with no answer and was refused my appointment — at a practice where I regularly wait 40–60 minutes past my own appointment time. The inconsistency, poor communication, and lack of effective care have completely broken my trust. I won’t be returning.

🚨 be aware - you DO NOT HAVE TO buy medicine from the vet - they can issue prescription and all online pet pharmacies have next day delivery. They put crazy margin on some products !! 🚨 I was also scammed. And paid £60 extra for no reason ! 🚨All vets so that. Not only this practice. So always ask for prescription to buy yourself or check on google how much that medicine to see how much you can save ! NEVER just agree to buy it without checking !
🚨🤬 was charged £76 for 25mil ear drops that can be bought with prescription for £15.99 !! No one offered alternative. Will be chasing them for response on this nonsense. …
Very kind and friendly staff

I found the veterinary staff and receptionists to be extremely helpful, informative and professional. I have a regular appointment for my pet bunny and the staff are always very attentive and helpful. It be difficult to find vets who do teeth incisor trims without anaesthetic - so really grateful to the team here.

I strongly do not recommend this veterinary clinic. We had an appointment scheduled before the castration of our dogs. The doctor explained everything to us and asked to do a blood test. Our first dog was taken to a separate room. About five minutes later, we heard heart-wrenching screams from our dog.

We went to the receptionist and asked them to return our dog. He came out terrified. The nurse who brought him out said that he didn’t let them take his blood. We were very surprised to hear that because our dog has had his blood taken many times in different clinics before, and everything was always fine. Yes, our dog is very emotional and active, but we had never heard him scream like that.

We offered to go in with him so that he would be less nervous. Then they decided to take blood from our older dog first. He is very calm and patient. The nurse couldn’t find a vein in a dog that was standing still. She kept poking him with the needle and pulling the syringe plunger nonstop. Our dog bravely endured this horror until the nurse finally found the vein. The blood was coming out very slowly — maybe she hadn’t inserted the needle correctly. She filled less than half of the test tube and said that it would be enough. Our older dog looked completely exhausted.

Then we lifted our second dog onto the table. My husband and I held him together with the nurse while the second nurse tried to take his blood. The dog was very nervous because, judging by his cries, they had hurt him before. We managed to hold him still so that the nurse could insert the needle. Our dog was patient. The nurse missed the vein. She poked our dog several times. Again, she missed the vein and began pulling the plunger of the syringe. Of course, no blood went into the syringe because the needle wasn’t in the vein. She pulled the syringe plunger at least five times, trying to draw blood from who knows where. Our dog was in a lot of pain and started to cry. The nurse still couldn’t take his blood. I had to carry him out because he was crying so much.

My husband was asked to stay with our older dog because it turned out that the blood they had taken was not enough. My husband said that the nurse again didn’t hit the vein the first time, and even our calm older dog started struggling from the stress and pain. We left in complete shock — but a financial shock was still waiting for us.

No one warned us that the fee for drawing the blood would cost more than the actual test itself. We were told the price would be £104 when we were asked if we agreed to do the test. But apparently, this clinic has a rule of not being transparent about prices. It turned out that the blood draw cost £50 plus £57 for the laboratory to issue the report. That’s pure deception and fraud.

When the doctor came out, I tried to explain that the nurse was unprofessional, couldn’t draw blood, and caused our dogs a lot of pain. The response was: “We have many dogs coming here for blood tests every day. The problem is with your dogs.”

At that moment, I realized there was no point talking any further. We took our dogs, bought them some treats, and hurried to get out of that horrible place.
Vicky is a kind, professional and knowledgeable vet. She was very good with my cat and shared a lot of practical tips.

One of my cat is ill, I take him to vet to  see what its wrong with him. First they give me a worms pills, but I told him he’s loosing weight. Take to vet second time with more weight loss and he take a blood test to see if he has anemia. Take him to vet for a 3 time because he doesn’t want to eat or drink anything. When I bring him back to vet I told to the doctor (Joseph )he don’t eat and drink and he want to take other blood tests to see if he have a infection , but I told him to take for liver function, kidney function. They kept him in from 9 AM until 6 PM. When I go to pick him up he told me he suspected he had FIP . From last week when I was at vet with him I feed him with syringe, and we called the vet to see if blood tests results came back , but all the time they said no. Yesterday when I called the vet and I asked about blood results one of the front reception just ended up. I called again and other one she said the results came and vet is going to call me back but that doesn’t happen. When I call them back they said the results didn’t come back. Thi it’s not first time when I have this problem. For me I feels like the focus isn’t really on the animals’ wellbeing anymore but more about the money.
I don’t recommend this centre to anyone because they don’t care about your pet they care how much money they get. They are not professionals, the front desks need to learning good manners to talk with people.
That happens to my cat  in the last 3 weeks . Today I take him to other clinic and when the doctor see him he told me if I keep him 1 more day with out treatment he will die. Now its in hospital.
